turns.text: Hi, I would like to book a tattoo.
Hi! What tattoo do you have in mind? Please share the approximate size, where you’d like it on your body, and which days or times usually work for you.
The idea is a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of my left forearm. I can come on weekday evenings.
Thanks! I’ve passed your tattoo idea and weekday evening availability to a colleague, who’ll take over from here. No appointment has been booked yet.

input.summary: Customer wants to book a paper boat tattoo, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of their left forearm. Available weekday evenings.
